abstract: Using data from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA), we estimate the impact of health on employment for individuals close to retirement age. Estimating the model separately by race and gender, we find that racial differences in employment can be partly explained by the worse health of minorities as well as the larger impact of health on employment for minorities.
abstract_zh: 利用健康与退休研究（HRS）和英国老龄化纵向研究（ELSA）的数据，我们估算了健康状况对临近退休年龄个体就业的影响。通过按种族和性别分别估计模型，我们发现种族间的就业差异可部分归因于少数族裔较差的健康状况，以及健康状况对少数族裔就业产生的更大影响。
title: The Dynamic Effects of Health on the Employment of Older Workers: Impacts by Gender, Country, and Race
title_zh: 健康对老年工人就业的动态效应：性别、国家与种族的影响

abstract: Why do political campaigns so often yield unexpected results? We address this question by separately estimating the direct effect of a campaign on targeted voters and the indirect effect on others in the same social environment. Partnering with a local NGO during Argentina’s 2023 presidential election, we randomized the distribution of leaflets providing an expert assessment of the consequences of the potentially dangerous proposals by the outsider candidate Javier Milei. Exploiting Argentina’s unique sub-precinct election reporting system, we show that the campaign reduced Milei’s support among directly treated voters, as expected, but increased his support among untreated voters in treated precincts, producing a backfiring, net-positive effect for Milei. A pre-registered replication confirmed these opposite-signed effects. Using theory and a survey experiment, we show that the minority of voters who disbelieved the campaign were more motivated to discuss it with peers, convincing them to support Milei. This mobilization effect appears especially likely when campaigns criticize outsider candidates. Our results highlight how campaigns aimed at anti-elite candidates can unintentionally mobilize support for them.
abstract_zh: 为何政治竞选活动常常产生出人意料的结果？我们通过分别估算竞选活动对目标选民的直接影响，以及对同一社会环境中其他选民的间接影响来探讨这一问题。在阿根廷2023年总统大选期间，我们与一家当地非政府组织合作，随机分发传单，内容为专家对局外人候选人哈维尔·米莱提出的潜在危险提案后果的评估。利用阿根廷独特的次选区选举报告系统，我们发现，该竞选活动如预期般降低了直接受干预选民对米莱的支持率，但反而提高了受干预选区中未受干预选民对他的支持率，从而对米莱产生了适得其反的净正面效应。一项预先注册的复制实验证实了这些符号相反的效应。通过理论分析和调查实验，我们证明，少数不相信该竞选活动的选民更有动力与同伴讨论此事，从而说服他们支持米莱。这种动员效应在竞选活动批评局外人候选人时尤为显著。我们的研究结果凸显了针对反精英候选人的竞选活动如何可能无意中为其动员支持。
title: Political Information and Network Effects

abstract: The canonical view of bankruptcy law is that it solves a market failure by imposing a collective choice process that supplants the market. We propose that bankruptcy law instead catalyzes the market if that process provides scope for rent seeking. Considering collective action problems as the central friction, as in the canonical theory, we argue that such a law induces activist investing that improves the efficiency of distressed restructuring. This expands the purview of bankruptcy law from a focus on bargaining issues to an active role in regulating corporate control contestability. We interpret the evolution of Chapter 11 and the surrounding market environment through this lens.
abstract_zh: 破产法的经典观点认为，它通过施加一种取代市场的集体选择过程来解决市场失灵问题。我们提出，如果该过程为寻租提供了空间，破产法反而会催化市场。与经典理论一致，将集体行动问题视为核心摩擦，我们认为此类法律会激发积极投资，从而提升困境重组的效率。这将破产法的范畴从聚焦谈判问题扩展至在规范公司控制权可竞争性方面发挥积极作用。我们通过这一视角解读第11章及其周边市场环境的演变。
title: Bankruptcy Law and the Market for Corporate Influence
title_zh: 破产法与公司影响力市场

abstract: From 1900 to 1940, ordinary working- and middle-class families saved for retirement and contingencies via ordinary life insurance policies. These policies combined insurance and savings in a single financial instrument that paid its face value to insured individuals who survived until maturity and to beneficiaries if the insured died before the maturity date. The popularity of these policies peaked before WWII when a substantial share of all households and most of the middle class invested in them. This paper explains why these policies were the most popular savings vehicle of their day. Ordinary life policies were well suited to the early twentieth-century economic environment. They had good returns; low risks; tax advantages; and little correlation with returns of competing investments, like bank deposits, building and loan shares, postal savings deposits, real estate, or stocks. The policies protected households from poverty in old age, from the premature death of their breadwinner, and from other risks including disability and deflation. Understanding how households saved in the past has implications for a wide range of literatures in the social sciences.
abstract_zh: 1900年至1940年间，普通工薪阶层与中产家庭通过普通人寿保险为退休生活及意外风险进行储蓄。这类保单将保险与储蓄功能整合于单一金融工具中：若投保人存活至保单到期日，可领取面值金额；若投保人在到期日前身故，则赔付给受益人。二战前，这类保单的普及度达到顶峰，当时相当比例的家庭及大多数中产阶级均持有此类投资。本文旨在阐释为何这类保单能成为当时最受欢迎的储蓄工具。普通人寿保险完美契合了20世纪初的经济环境：其兼具高回报率、低风险、税收优惠，且与银行存款、建房贷款协会股份、邮政储蓄存款、房地产或股票等竞争性投资的收益率相关性极低。此类保单不仅保障家庭免于老年贫困、家庭支柱早逝风险，还能抵御残疾及通货紧缩等其他风险。理解历史上的家庭储蓄模式，对社会科学领域的诸多文献具有重要启示意义。
title: Ordinary Life Insurance: The Best-Performing Financial Asset of the 1930s
title_zh: 普通人寿保险：20世纪30年代表现最佳的金融资产
